name: wallet
description: A wallet or stored payment balance.
useCase: Open a wallet or view stored payment methods beside its label.
misuse: Do not use the wallet alone to indicate an available balance or a completed payment.

16.reason: A taller clasp gives its fastener dot 1px of vertical space while retaining the original wallet silhouette.

24.reason: A larger clasp keeps at least 1.5px around its fastener dot and remains joined to the original wallet outline.
